## A chart

```{r}
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 5.2
set.seed(1)
d <- tidyr::expand_grid(group = paste("Group", 1:4), period = 1:13) |>
  mutate(value = runif(n(), 20, 120) + period * 4)
ggplot(d, aes(period, value, colour = group)) + geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_colour_phw_d(key = "group") +
  labs(x = "Period", y = "Value", caption = phw_caption("Example data"))
```
